output.population: Adults aged 20 to 65 years with type 2 diabetes diagnosed within 6 years, BMI 27 to 45, and not receiving insulin
output.intervention: Primary-care weight-management program including medication withdrawal, total diet replacement, food reintroduction, and structured weight-maintenance support
output.outcome: At least 15 kg weight loss and diabetes remission at 12 months
output.effect: At least 15 kg weight loss occurred in 24% versus 0%; diabetes remission occurred in 46% versus 4%, odds ratio 19.7 (95% CI 7.8 to 49.8).
output.applicability_boundary: Multicomponent primary-care program; effects cannot be attributed to diet alone.
